name: Kishore Sharma
text: I recently visited CAFEIN in nabarangpur and had a pleasant experience. I ordered Arrabiata spaghetti,ceaser salad,loaded french fries, Subway veg, hazelnut latte which was fresh, flavorful, and well presented. The café had a comfortable ambience, attractive décor, and clean seating areas. The staff were polite and service was reasonably quick. The prices were affordable for the quality and portion size. Overall, it is a good place for a quick coffee/family time.
